text:
lauren_sales: Kickoff for ACME POC. They want quick validation on two features: (1) rapid issue triage (classify ticket into intent buckets) and (2) product-catalog tagging (extract SKUs, categories, vendor names). Need baseline prompts, ~40 eval pairs per flow, and a simple cost/persona slide for the deck.

devin_se: Got it. Can you confirm perf targets and any security must-haves?

lauren_sales: p95 latency <= 250ms, target cost <= $0.004 per request if possible. Must run in-customer VPC (no public egress). Also they asked about data retention and model artifacts in the security questionnaire.

priya_ml: For baseline strategy: two model options — small(7B q8) for tagging and medium(13B q4/q8) for classification if they want higher accuracy. Recommend hybrid: run extraction/tagging on 7B, run final intent classification on 13B only for low-confidence cases. That reduces avg cost.

priya_ml: Proposed eval metrics: tagging -> micro-F1 and exact-match rate; classification -> accuracy + top-2 recall. Also include a small human qualitative check (5-way blind) for edge cases.

lauren_sales: Nice. Sales asked for one-liner cost formula we can put on slide.

devin_se: One-liner: cost_per_request = price_per_1k_tokens * (avg_input_tokens + avg_output_tokens) / 1000 + infra_margin. Use price_per_1k_tokens = $0.90 for 13B quant estimate, $0.30 for 7B quant dev baseline (example).

priya_ml: Baseline prompt drafts (feel free to tweak):

```
# Intent classification (zero-shot)
You are an automated ticket triage assistant. Given the conversation thread, return a single label from: [billing, technical, feature_request, account, other].
Tone: terse.
Input: <<THREAD>>
Output: <LABEL>
```

```
# Tagging (few-shot example)
Example 1:
Thread: "Customer: My 42mm blue strap keeps detaching from the clasp. Order #12345."
Tags: ["SKU: STRP-42-BL", "issue: hardware", "order: 12345"]

Now tag the input:
Input: <<THREAD>>
Output: [ ... ]
```

lauren_sales: Good. Priya, can you generate 40 eval pairs per flow using the sample pack the customer shared? Also capture avg token counts for each sample so we can compute cost.

priya_ml: I can generate 40 each within 48 hours. Will attach a small CSV: columns = (id, input_text, expected_output, input_tokens, output_tokens).

marco_eng: Blocker note: because they require VPC-only, we'll need to provision a Dedicated/Private plan (no hosted fallback). That affects SLA and rollout timing. Also need to prepare a model provenance one-pager for whichever open model we propose (name, license, known risks).

lauren_sales: Legal also requested encryption details and retention policy wording for the SQA. Eva can you start drafting those fields?

eva_success: On it. I'll fill: data at rest encrypted with customer KMS; no model weights or prompts leave their VPC; logs retained for 30 days default (customer can request shorter). I'll add a short paragraph on export controls.

devin_se: Perf follow-up: I'll run a quick micro-benchmark on our dev GPU and post tokens/sec numbers. Expect to be able to meet 250ms for 7B; 13B may be borderline depending on sequence length.

priya_ml: Note on evaluation: pick a balanced mix of short (10-30 tokens) and medium (100-200 tokens) threads so latency estimates are representative.

lauren_sales: Timeline check: deliverables due in 3 business days for initial baseline (prompts + 40 evals per flow + cost slide). Can everyone confirm?

priya_ml: Confirm.

marco_eng: Confirm, but need 24h to provision dev infra to mirror VPC constraints.

eva_success: Confirm. Uploading SQA snippets to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/acme/poc-docs

lauren_sales: Action items recap: Priya -> produce prompts + 40 eval CSVs + token counts. Devin -> perf numbers + token/sec. Marco -> model provenance one-pager + infra note for runbook. Eva -> SQA retention + encryption answers. I'll assemble the one-slide cost summary after you post numbers. Thanks :rocket:
